points.description: Names at least two of the three forces: pressure force, gravitational (body) force, viscous force (any wording, e.g. gravity, friction/viscosity).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming only one of the three correctly... or 0.75 if two are named but vaguely

points.description: Covers the full set: pressure, gravitational and viscous forces all identified.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming all three forces, or about three quarters of them (two clearly correct with the third hinted at) in any wording, e.g. gravity, body force, friction or viscosity. Give 1 mark if only one correct force is named or the answer is vague. Give 0 if the forces are wrong or unrelated; extra remarks such as inertia do not cost marks.
